summary: Cabrinha's legendary all-around kite now in its 20th+ iteration. The Switchblade delivers reliable performance across all conditions with excellent depower and a forgiving power delivery.

sources.summary: A reliable workhorse that does everything well. Riders appreciate the predictable power and wide wind range.
Often recommended for beginners and intermediate riders. Solid build quality and forgiving characteristics.
Praised for its consistency year after year. Great depower range and a kite you can trust in varying conditions.

reviews.summary: Anthony from Kiteboarding St Petersburg shares his first-ride impressions of the 2025 Switchblade in around 15 knots. His headline takeaway is that the kite feels noticeably lighter than previous versions thanks to the new Apex material in the leading edge, while remaining smooth and predictable. He highlights its versatility for both hooked-in and unhooked riding, and was confident enough on it to land his first backside 360 since an ACL injury.

structured_review.summary: The 2025 Cabrinha Switchblade continues its legacy as a reliable all-around freeride kite, now upgraded with Apex material in the leading edge for a noticeably lighter and more responsive feel. It delivers smooth, predictable power that works both hooked in and unhooked. With only one short first-ride impression available, deeper performance nuances remain to be seen.
pros: Noticeably lighter feel thanks to new Apex material in the leading edge
Strong kite awareness — easy to feel where it is in the window
Forgiving enough to build confidence after injury or time off the water
cons: Only tested in moderate conditions (~15 knots), high-wind and low-wind performance not assessed
Very limited reviewer feedback — single short session, no detailed technical breakdown
No commentary on turning speed, bar pressure, or relaunch
structured_review.best_for: Freeride riders who want a dependable, versatile kite that performs confidently across disciplines without demanding technical finesse.
structured_review.not_for: Riders seeking in-depth performance data or specialized wave/big-air capabilities — this iteration hasn't been thoroughly reviewed yet.
structured_review.rec_blurb: Twenty-year icon gets lighter: the Switchblade's Apex upgrade is a real step forward.
